description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the proprietary Blueprint, high-order directives, template formats, skillId mapping, and grading rubrics. (2) Generate exam_ch7.md covering all 6 Bloom levels with the standard Blueprint percentages (10/20/30/25/10/5%), high-order total ≥40%, ≥12% innovative questions, at least 1 question explicitly labeled 诊断/比选/构造, difficulty ratio 3:5:2, and correct ODE skillId strings (常微分方程Skill/常微分方程求解Skill). (3) Generate homework_ch7.md using the exact emoji-prefixed three-tier template (🟢基础题 35%, 🟡进阶层 45%, 🔴挑战题 20%) with per-question metadata (预计Xmin, ⭐rating, 认知:Bloom-level), ≥2 high-order task types from the table (错误诊断/多法比选/表征转换/条件弱化/约束建模), ≥1 multi-solution or error-diagnosis question, common error traps, hints, and ODE skillId. (4) Generate grading_ch7_studentA.md that identifies the logical flaw in the student's existence proof (using '显然' without verification = logical jump), validates the correct calculation, classifies errors using the 5-type taxonomy, applies all 4 high-order scoring dimensions (论证结构/策略质量/批判性/表达严谨性), follows the three-step feedback rhetoric (affirm valid steps → point out highest-value improvement → provide actionable next step), and does NOT simply rewrite the complete solution.
